body:
I was able to avoid this by removing the `.godot` directory.

While trying to reproduce: 
  - Sometimes edits would work properly after deleting a script which, when deleted, would cause another script to fail to parse (dependent class.)
  - There seemed to be no connection between the files deleted, where they were used, and how it had an effect on this bug.  It just felt like things "shook up enough" to work.
  - It seemed non-repeatable all around.
  - My gut tells me this has *something* to do with cached Script classes and autocomplete?
  - The original project was from 4.5, which stayed current with 4.6 and now 4.7

I'll leave this open in case some useful tags can be added before this issue is closed, but I don't think I'll be able to get an MRP.

Can replicate similar behavior by calling `reload_text` in `_text_edit_gui_input` in `ScriptTextEditor`. It seems this issue comes from `reload_text` being called before `edited_res` is updated. Because of the delay seen in the video I would also assume it has something to do with code completion or `validate_script`, but I didn't find where either would cause a call to `reload_text`.

For reference https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/114917 made a lot of changes to the script editor and could be the cause for this, but the modification I tested also replicates the behavior in previous commits. In case you still have a project where this happens it would be nice if you could test it with a commit before the PR was merged, like f4f0679a2d4a2b8e6da8700412b387fc1ccad951
